summary: David finds Saul in a cave and spares his life—Saul confesses that David is more righteous than he—David swears that he will not cut off the seed of Saul.
meta_description: David finds Saul in a cave and spares his life—Saul confesses that David is more righteous than he—David swears that he will not cut off the seed of Saul.

footnotes.note3_a: OR sheepfolds; shelters, probably caves with stone walls about the entrance.
footnotes.note4_a: OR hem, corner, border which signifies the portion that symbolized his authority (also vv. 5, 11).
